newsitem.title: USA: Forest Labs expects lower Q2 sales, earnings.
newsitem.headline: Forest Labs expects lower Q2 sales, earnings.

text.p: Forest Laboratories Inc said Thursday that sales and earnings for its fiscal second quarter and for its full fiscal year ending March 31, 1997, will be lower than originally expected.
The company said continued deterioration of pricing and market share of its Inwood generic subsidiary was one of the reasons for the lower expectations.
Forest Labs also cited the loss of Lorcet 10/650 sales as a result of generic substitution.
However, results of its new product introductions and future product developments are expected to "significantly increase" earnings by the end of the fiscal year, it said.
